receipt.equivalence_review: Correct closed-world refusal. The author inspected full block and part inventories after preserving failed positional searches, then examined physical ADC, monitor, reference, photodiode and output-buffer contracts. I independently checked the pinned 8 SPS ADC setting and grounded AIN3, onboard INA219 shunt connections, internal photodiode summing node and voltage-follower feedback. These exported functions do not implement the requested four-wire PT100 excitation and calibrated conversion. The silicon ADC maximum rate is not confused with the fixed block setting; raw parts are not treated as an implemented eligible block.

refusal.reason: No eligible catalog block or combination of exported block functions provides the required 100 uA four-wire PT100 excitation and independent differential sensing with calibrated 0–100 degC conversion, 0.5 degC absolute error and >=10 Hz 3.3 V UART reporting. The inspected ADC block is a fixed 8 SPS voltage acquisition circuit without excitation or RTD conversion. Current-monitor blocks sense an installed 0.1 ohm shunt rather than independently excite/sense an external PT100; the thermistor, silicon temperature sensor, photodiode frontend, voltage-reference, DAC and unity-follower contracts do not supply the missing RTD function. Raw op-amp or ADC part availability does not create an eligible reviewed RTD block.
